derivation: Only the final consolidated Round 3 Description. Existing implementation/tests/results are not the expectation oracle.

R01.requirement: All product copy and synthetic records are English; show the synthetic-only disclaimer; use fictional data.

R02.requirement: Eleven primary patient areas, consistent navigation, loading/empty/error/success states, confirmations, breadcrumbs, responsive accessible controls.

R03.requirement: Personalized persisted overview: appointments, results, unread messages, medications, balance, visits, notifications and five quick actions.

R04.requirement: Registration, login, hashed passwords, logout, profile editing, password change, sessions and role/object access control.

R05.requirement: Logout clears cached session/patient records, immediately returns to sign-in and permits account switching without refresh.

R06.requirement: Registration/change/recovery confirm password, validate strength/equality, provide accessible visibility controls and clear fields on success.

R07.requirement: Forgot password uses a clearly marked local simulated mailbox and expiring single-use reset links.

R08.source_heading: V2-MT-003 Account-type registration and landing pages
R08.requirement: Mutually exclusive Patient, Family caregiver, Care team selection precedes role-specific form; allow choice changes; correct patient/caregiver landing.

R09.source_heading: V2-MT-003 Account-type registration and landing pages
R09.requirement: Physician/Nurse/Front Desk/Billing Staff applications include organization, remain unprivileged pending review; administrator approval/decline needs verification note; no public Administrator.

R10.requirement: Upcoming/past appointments, instructions, slot provider/type/date selection and six appointment types.

R11.requirement: Booking persists to patient/dashboard/staff; availability validation, scheduling-conflict and double-booking prevention.

R12.requirement: Cancellation records reason/history; previsit questionnaire and simulated eCheck-In persist; enforce status transitions.

R13.requirement: Patients request rescheduling; staff replaces appointment, opens replacement, preserves separate cancellation histories; upcoming earliest first, consistent timezones.

R14.requirement: Staff manage providers, departments/availability, appointments and statuses.

R15.requirement: Results display test, collection/result dates, value, unit, reference range, status, flag, provider and comments; no inferred diagnoses.

R16.requirement: Result name/date filtering, details, historical measurements/trend charts, Pending/Preliminary/Final/Corrected states.

R17.requirement: Staff create initially unpublished results and publish; patient notification/visibility; withdrawal blocks details and direct exports.

R18.requirement: Inbox/Sent, new message, recipient/team, five categories, threaded replies, read/unread, staff inbox, persisted messages, non-emergency notice.

R19.requirement: Archive/restore confirm, navigate to correct selected destination folder, specific success and visible thread; only applicable action, cancel unchanged, error retains detail; per-user state.

R20.requirement: Active/history/search and full medication details including strength, dosage, route, frequency, dates, provider, pharmacy, status, instructions.

R21.requirement: Simulated refill submission/staff review, Requested/Under Review/Approved/Denied/Completed; prevent duplicate pending requests with clear explanation; show progress/decision.

R22.requirement: Medication and health corrections are requests/self-reported, not silent edits to official data; staff maintain official records.

R23.requirement: Demographics, conditions, allergies, medications, immunizations, medical/surgical/family/social history, care team, vitals, preventive care.

R24.requirement: Visit detail: date/provider/department/type/reason/diagnoses/summary/follow-up/shared notes/AVS; staff creates and publishes; private/unpublished notes hidden.

R25.requirement: Invoices, insurance, outstanding balance/history, all specified invoice fields and statuses; staff creates; simulated payments update exact balances and transactions.

R26.requirement: Prevent duplicate processing of same payment request; input validation; no real card collection/live processing.

R27.requirement: Seven document types, list/filter/open/download/date/linked encounter; generated synthetic content; authorization on every file access.

R28.source_heading: V2-MT-002 Document previews and PDF downloads
R28.requirement: Web preview, Download PDF, Print for labs/documents/AVS/statements/receipts; real application/pdf and descriptive .pdf names from same authorized representation.

R29.source_heading: V2-MT-002 Document previews and PDF downloads
R29.requirement: PDF branding, patient/available provider identifiers, reference/dates, values/units/ranges/status/exact amounts, disclaimer/page numbers; wrap and paginate long text.

R30.source_heading: V2-MT-002 Document previews and PDF downloads
R30.requirement: Withdrawn labs, unpublished visits/documents, unrelated patients and disallowed/revoked proxy sections blocked at direct exports and UI.

R31.requirement: Visible Link a family member; invite to own records or request another account; explicit section scopes and incoming/outgoing status, expiry, relationship/actions; local delivery disclosure.

R32.requirement: Authenticated intended recipient explicitly accepts/declines; email/name match alone insufficient; bind invitations including registration, profile email edits cannot claim.

R33.requirement: Cancel pending; block duplicates, expired/reused acceptance; owner revoke/proxy remove; old invitation cannot silently restore revoked access.

R34.requirement: Linked profile switching exposes only granted sections; staff grants/revokes; enforce permission changes on subsequent requests and audit.

R35.requirement: Dependent/guardian access requires administrator verification, never self-granted; synthetic verification limitations disclosed.

R36.requirement: Results/messages/upcoming appointments/cancellations/refills/bills/payments notifications; read/unread/list/deep links/mark-read/preferences; local operation no external mail dependency.

R37.requirement: Staff categorized searchable/group-filtered work areas and compact selector; immediate focused detail drawer with close/back, patient/module preserved, keyboard/mobile no overflow.

R38.requirement: Readable permission/unavailable/validation errors and way back, no internal query/model errors; readable staff names/dates instead of raw IDs where possible.

R39.requirement: Role/object authorization, sessions, CSRF, input validation, sensitive-data isolation and secure document access.

R40.requirement: Audit login, record access, appointment changes, lab publication, medication changes, refill decisions, proxy permission and billing changes.
